member.name: T:Stop_Random_Relation.RelationCleanupEngine
member.summary: Thread-safe, zero-reflection relationship pruning engine parameterized by an struct adapter.

remarks.para: Time complexity per event is O(R), where R is the number of direct relations on the evaluated pawn. Off-map sweep complexity is O(N + K * R), where N is total world pawns and K is the number of world pawns that actually have direct relations.

Auxiliary space is amortized O(1) on repeated invocations via thread-local buffer reuse (rent/return for re-entrancy safety). Concurrent modifications to both endpoints use canonical lock ordering via to eliminate deadlocks.
